studio.warningDesc: Heavy effects can overload weak CPUs and make playback stutter or crackle.
studio.warningRecommendWeak: Recommended for low-powered devices: Enable pre-calculation. (Note: The more effects you enable, the longer the calculation will take).

masterOutput.title: Master Output
masterOutput.desc: Final stage output controls and panning.
masterOutput.loudnessDesc: Measures each track and applies fixed LUFS gain with peak-safe headroom. Best quality when pre-calculation is enabled.
masterOutput.hqOversampleDesc: Uses a 4x FIR oversampled soft clipper to reduce clipping aliasing. May be heavy on weak phones.
masterOutput.precalcIdleDesc: For weak CPUs with enough RAM: renders each track before playback so heavy effects do not have to run in real time. This normal mode handles one track at a time, not the whole queue. EQ/Effects changes apply on the next track.
masterOutput.fullQueueCacheDesc: Keep precalculated audio buffers for the entire queue in RAM and unlock full-queue pre-calculation. Allows instant playback of any rendered track, but consumes significantly more memory.
masterOutput.analyserFftDesc: Determines the resolution of the frequency spectrum. Increase for a smoother, more detailed graph, or decrease (256 - 1024) on weak devices to save CPU and prevent stuttering.
masterOutput.latencyDesc: Similar to Block Size in a DAW. Determines audio buffer size. Choose Playback to give the device more time to process EQ, preventing crackling/stuttering. (Note: Changes only apply on page reload).
masterOutput.enableFullQueueFirst: Enable Full Queue RAM Cache First
masterOutput.queuePrecalcDesc: Detected {{cores}} CPU cores. Recommended: {{workers}} workers. Max: {{maxWorkers}} workers.
masterOutput.queuePrecalcDescSingleWorker: Detected {{cores}} CPU cores. This device is limited to 1 safe worker to avoid browser lag.

eq.title: Equalizer
eq.noteDesc: Switch to Advanced (10-Band) or Custom tab to freely adjust frequency sliders.
eq.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete preset '{name}'?
eq.blockSizeDesc: Determines EQ precision (especially for bass). Increase for smoother and more accurate sound, or decrease (512 - 1024) on weak devices to save CPU and prevent stuttering.

tone.title: Preamp & Tone
tone.desc: Global gain adjustments and bass/treble tuning.

dynamics.title: Web Audio Balancer v2.1
dynamics.desc: 3-Stage Dynamics: K-Weighted RMS Leveler -> Peak Guard -> Lookahead Soft Limiter.
dynamics.modeDesc: Select automatic loudness balancing mode or switch to Custom to fine-tune all parameters.
dynamics.customHint: Switch mode to Custom or pick a template above to fine-tune all 11 parameters.
dynamics.kWeightDesc: Applies ITU-R BS.1770 K-Weighting (+4 dB high-shelf & 75 Hz high-pass) to measure perceived loudness instead of raw RMS.
dynamics.limiterDesc: Catches final output peaks after soft clipping, reducing crackling when EQ, preamp, or effects raise the level. Recommended to leave on if CPU is powerful enough.
dynamics.hqOversampleDesc: Greatly reduces aliasing distortion during heavy limiting, but consumes significant CPU.

spatial.reverbDesc: Add space and depth using Convolution Reverb (10-direction measured KEMAR HRTF 3D Early Reflections & 360° Diffuse Tail).
spatial.stereoDesc: Widen your soundstage using Linkwitz-Riley 12 dB/oct crossover, M/S processing, 3D differential diffusion, and 4-voice Dimension D chorus.
spatial.speakerModeDesc: Optimize spatialization for your speaker setup.
spatial.speakerModeHelp: Smart 1-Speaker uses a 90° orthogonal phase-shift network (Hilbert Allpass) to preserve all stereo details on a single speaker without phase cancellation.
spatial.surroundDesc: 240 Hz Butterworth HPF, 2-stage Schroeder all-pass diffuser & 4 inharmonic taps with progressive air absorption damping. 100% phase-safe in mono.
spatial.chorusDesc: Dimension D style 4-voice quadrature chorus with 4-point Hermite cubic interpolation and analog BBD bandpass (200 Hz - 9 kHz).
spatial.stereoInsideDesc: Stereo Imager will ONLY affect frequencies INSIDE this range (2nd-order Linkwitz-Riley 12 dB/oct with 0 dB phase-aligned sum).
spatial.stereoOutsideDesc: Stereo Imager will ONLY affect frequencies OUTSIDE this range (2nd-order Linkwitz-Riley 12 dB/oct with 0 dB phase-aligned sum).
spatial.stereoFftDesc: Sampling resolution for L/R channel correlation analysis. Default 1024 for high smoothness, can be adjusted up to 16384 or down to 256.
spatial.reverbEngineDesc: Choose "Procedural" for extreme web loading speed (uses local CPU power) or "File-based" for the most realistic reverb (reduces CPU load but uses more RAM and network).

settings.metadataParserDesc: Choose the global ID3 tag parsing and album cover extraction engine for all tracks.
settings.modernParserDesc: Optimized for speed and streaming audio data extraction directly in modern browsers.
settings.legacyParserDesc: More accurate at extracting ID3 metadata and album art from complex tag structures and legacy audio formats.
settings.legacyNoteContent: The Legacy parser (music-metadata-browser) can extract metadata and album cover art (ID3 APIC tags) more accurately and reliably than the modern parser in many cases (particularly with local files or complex MP3 tags). Switch to Legacy if your tracks are missing info or album covers.
settings.refreshCurrentMeta: Refresh metadata for currently playing track
settings.refreshMetaSuccess: Track metadata and cover art successfully refreshed!
settings.shortcutsDesc: Control your music playback instantly with hotkeys
settings.analysisPerfDesc: Customize the resolution of audio analysis blocks. Higher values (like 8192, 16384) provide extreme accuracy but consume significant CPU and RAM. Decrease if you experience lag.
settings.masterFftDesc: Determines the sharpness of the visual frequency spectrum. Increase for smoother visuals, decrease (256-1024) on weaker devices to save CPU.
settings.stereoFftDesc: L/R correlation analysis sample rate for Stereo Imager effect. Default is 1024. Increasing it expands the stereo field accurately but uses much more resources.
settings.fft256: 256 (Ultra light / Rough / For very weak devices)
settings.fft8192: 8192 (Very high / Very smooth / Heavy on CPU)
settings.fft16384: 16384 (Max / Ultra sharp / Very heavy on CPU)
